text.title: Spring Boot Layered Architecture Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to scaffold a Spring Boot 3 layered service end-to-end.

step.name: add-controller
step.action: Add `@RestController` under `Features/<Feature>/`. Define the request DTO as a `record` carrying Bean Validation annotations and bind it with `@Valid`. Inject the service; each method makes exactly one service call and returns a record DTO. No `@Transactional`, no repository, no orchestration in this layer.
step.decision-gate: If a method returns an entity, BLOCK per `dto-record-never-entity` rule.
If the controller annotates `@Transactional` or autowires a repository, BLOCK per `thin-controller` and `transactional-on-service-only` rules.
If a request DTO is not a record or carries no validation annotations, BLOCK per `record-dtos-with-validation` rule.

step.name: add-service-with-transactional
step.action: Add `@Service` class; annotate class `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`; override on writes with `@Transactional`. Inject `PasswordEncoder` for password hashing.
step.decision-gate: If a write method lacks `@Transactional`, BLOCK per `transactional-on-writes` rule.

step.name: add-repository
step.action: Add `JpaRepository<Entity, Long>` subinterface. Add custom JPQL only where derived queries fall short. Use `Specification` for complex filters. List queries return `Page<Entity>`.
step.decision-gate: If list query returns `List` without `Pageable`, BLOCK per `pageable-on-list` rule.

step.name: wire-mapstruct-and-dto
step.action: Define record DTO; add `@Mapper(componentModel = "spring") interface FooMapper`. Verify the MapStruct annotation processor is configured. Map inside service before returning.

step.name: add-global-exception-advice-and-tests
step.action: Add `@RestControllerAdvice` mapping `ResourceNotFoundException` → 404, `ValidationException` → 400, etc., into RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` — never a bespoke error envelope. If the feature needs async work, extract the `@Async` methods into their own bean and define a named `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor` with explicit core size, max size and queue capacity. Add controller/service tests per `java-junit-testing`.
step.output: Consistent ProblemDetail error responses + AsyncConfig where needed + green tests
step.decision-gate: If `@Async` is self-invoked or has no named executor, BLOCK per `async-via-named-executor` rule.
